reasons.plausibility: Al has very limited solubility in refractory BCC alloys and tends to form brittle intermetallics (e.g., with Zr, Ti), making retention of a single-phase BCC structure and preservation of strength highly unlikely.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiment with systematic Al substitutions, phase analysis, and quantitative density/strength rejection criteria is clear and would decisively test the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core trade-off but proposes a well-known embrittling element without acknowledging its metallurgical incompatibility, limiting its practical value.
